summary: This bill requires the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to create and maintain a public online database, called the National Utility Rate Change Tracker, to provide information on approved and effective utility rate changes, including their impact on customer bills and utility revenue.

scores.thoughts: This bill requires the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to establish and maintain a new online database, the National Utility Rate Change Tracker. This new responsibility for FERC will entail some level of government spending for its creation and ongoing maintenance, though the bill does not specify an appropriation amount.

The bill mandates the creation of a publicly accessible, searchable online database for utility rate changes. This involves data collection, standardization, and public presentation, which falls under the umbrella of government technology initiatives and data transparency, though not directly privacy.
